verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing government service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt on the Corporations Canada / ISED site. The only probe tested the open.canada.ca CKAN API, which says nothing about crawl directives for the registry.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
